justifications.r1: Karametra land-fetch triggers on every creature cast ramp 10+ lands ahead of curve, plus Smothering Tithe.
justifications.r2: Beast Whisperer, The Great Henge, and angel draw triggers maintain hand replenishment.
justifications.a1: Worldly Tutor, Eladamri's Call, and creature redundancy find key angels.
justifications.a2: Achieves high-mana Angel deployment by Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents flying angel board pressure on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to swing for lethal across 3 players.
justifications.p3: Visible high-flying threats; heavily telegraphed combat wins.
justifications.i1: Path, Swords, Beast Within, and Generous Gift spot removal suite.
justifications.i2: Aura Shards repeatedly destroys all opposing artifacts/enchantments on every creature cast.
justifications.s1: Teferi's Protection, Heroic Intervention, and Avacyn indestructible shielding.
justifications.s2: Massive land base allows fast re-casting of angels after wipes.
justifications.s3: Indestructible commander; deck functions well once lands are pulled from library.
